top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level synthesizable integration module that exposes the PicoRV32/Wishbone system, MMIO control/status registers, streaming model transport ports, safety monitors, actuator command output, and UART debug observability. This module is the required design top and must not be replaced by a status-only, telemetry-only, register-bank-only, or leaf module.
top_module.functionality: Implements a complete soft-CPU-controlled active-aerodynamics wrapper: PicoRV32-compatible Wishbone memory-mapped control plane, bounded request/response transport to an external aerodynamic surrogate, safety validation, stale-data and timeout monitoring, sequence checking, clamp and fallback actuation, and UART debug mirroring. The top-level owns the external contract and must ensure every declared register is implemented through RTL decode and that every top-level output is driven by real RTL logic.
responsibilities: Instantiate and integrate the PicoRV32-compatible Wishbone CPU subsystem.
Expose a real firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, transaction-valid/write-enable, and response/ready semantics.
Implement register decode for CTRL, STATUS, SEQ_OUT, SEQ_IN, STALE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT_LIMIT, CLAMP_MIN, CLAMP_MAX, FALLBACK_CMD, LAST_CMD, LAST_RSP_META, and FAULT_CODE.
Provide compact model-request transport outputs and model-response transport inputs using valid/ready semantics.
Capture request sequence and compact flow-condition summary on software request_start when enabled.
Validate model responses for sequence match, freshness, and metadata format before allowing actuator updates.
Latch faults on stale data, timeout, malformed response, sequence mismatch, missing handshake progress, and clamp events until software clear_fault.
Clamp actuator commands to configured limits and substitute fallback command on reset and unrecoverable faults.
Provide UART debug mirroring of status and telemetry without making UART required for safety.
Keep all payloads compact and bounded; do not store bulk flow fields in registers or transport them on top-level ports.
Respect the external transport direction contract: model_req_valid/data are outputs, model_req_ready is an input, model_rsp_valid/data are inputs, and model_rsp_ready is an output.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset, disable outputs, clear pending request state, clear handshake valid signals, set actuator output to FALLBACK_CMD, clear or deassert request/response progress flags, and assert fallback_active until software explicitly re-arms the system. Faults are not cleared by reset only if software-visible latched status requires explicit clear after idle; otherwise the safe default after reset is fallback active and not armed.
behavior_rules: All top-level outputs must have real RTL drivers; never leave a required output connected only to a child input.
The top-level Wishbone ports must be implemented as a real firmware-visible control plane and not as a placeholder.
The request payload width must not exceed 128 bits.
Do not expose geometry arrays, pressure fields, flow fields, or other large tensors at top level.
The model request bridge may only send compact scalar summaries such as stream velocity, sequence number, geometry handle or identifier, operating mode, and versioned header.
The response bridge must accept only compact aerodynamic outputs and metadata such as drag summary, lift summary, control recommendation summary, validity bits, and sequence number.
Any timeout on request or response progress must latch a fault and force fallback command behavior.
Any stale response or sequence mismatch must latch a fault and reject the command.
Actuator command values must be clamped to [CLAMP_MIN, CLAMP_MAX] before issuance.
When fallback_active is asserted, FALLBACK_CMD must be driven instead of a model-derived command.
Fault clear is only allowed when the system is idle and software writes clear_fault explicitly.
UART debug may mirror telemetry but cannot be required for safety operation.
The MMIO register decode must be reachable for every declared register; inaccessible state must not be labeled software-visible.
The design must remain fully synthesizable with single-clock operation.

modules.name: pico_wishbone_cpu_subsystem
modules.description: PicoRV32-compatible CPU subsystem with Wishbone master interface, instruction and data memory hooks, and interrupt support. This module represents the resolved soft CPU contract for firmware execution and control-plane access.
modules.functionality: Implements the PicoRV32 soft CPU contract with Wishbone master signaling suitable for firmware control, register access, and interrupt handling. The CPU executes generated firmware that configures the model transport, writes request metadata, reads response metadata, and manages control/status sequencing.
responsibilities: Provide the Wishbone master side of the firmware control path.
Accept interrupt indication from the top-level safety/telemetry logic.
Drive memory-mapped accesses to the top-level register block and any required on-chip memories or interconnect.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset the CPU into a known halted or reset state with bus outputs deasserted until released by reset_n.
behavior_rules: Must be compatible with the resolved PicoRV32 contract.
Must not be claimed as board-ready unless synthesized together with memory and application RTL.
All bus outputs are owned by this subsystem and consumed by the interconnect/control plane.

modules.name: aero_mmio_register_bank
modules.description: Wishbone-mapped firmware-visible control/status register bank implementing the authoritative register map for the aero control wrapper. It decodes all declared registers and exposes semantic control outputs used by the transport, safety, and actuator logic.
modules.functionality: Decodes the full firmware-visible MMIO register contract and converts software writes into explicit semantic control signals. It also returns telemetry/status values from the safety and actuator logic and must ensure every declared register is reachable through RTL decode.
responsibilities: Implement CTRL, STATUS, SEQ_OUT, SEQ_IN, STALE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT_LIMIT, CLAMP_MIN, CLAMP_MAX, FALLBACK_CMD, LAST_CMD, LAST_RSP_META, and FAULT_CODE registers.
Expose CTRL fields enable, clear_fault, arm_fallback, and request_start as separate semantic outputs.
Expose status and telemetry inputs for firmware readback.
Provide Wishbone transaction acknowledge and data return behavior.
Ensure no declared register is inaccessible or software-only in name only.
modules.reset_behavior: Clear write side effects, deassert control outputs, and return readable telemetry to safe defaults. Register state should be initialized to conservative values consistent with fallback operation.
behavior_rules: CTRL fields must include enable, clear_fault, arm_fallback, and request_start.
Every declared register must be reachable through decode.
STATUS must expose busy, request_pending, response_valid, stale_reject, timeout_fault, clamp_active, fallback_active, and fault_latched indicators.
FAULT_CODE must encode stale data, timeout, sequence mismatch, malformed response, and actuator clamp events.
This module provides the canonical firmware-visible control-plane interface and may coexist with streaming transport but must not be replaced by it.

modules.name: model_request_bridge
modules.description: Compact request bridge that captures control-plane request events, packs scalar summary metadata into a bounded request payload, and presents a valid/ready streaming request to the external aerodynamic surrogate runtime.
modules.functionality: Captures software request-start events when enabled, assembles a compact and versioned request packet containing only scalar summaries, sequence number, geometry identifier, operating mode, and header version, and drives the external model request valid/data until ready or timeout. The bridge never emits payloads larger than 128 bits and never stores bulk flow fields.
responsibilities: Capture current sequence number and compact flow-condition summary on request start.
Assert model_req_valid until model_req_ready is observed or timeout expires.
Maintain request_pending and busy indications.
Signal timeout when the request cannot be accepted within the programmable limit.
Keep request payload bounded to 128 bits or less.
Provide sequence and age outputs for downstream safety logic.
modules.reset_behavior: Clear pending state, deassert valid, clear age counters, and return to idle. Fallback remains available and may be asserted by higher-level logic on reset.
behavior_rules: Only scalar summaries may be packed into request data.
The payload width must remain at or below 128 bits.
Timeout expiry must produce a fault indication to the safety/fallback chain.
No bulk field storage or tensor buffering is allowed in RTL.

modules.name: model_response_bridge
modules.description: Response bridge that accepts valid responses from the external aerodynamic surrogate, checks response sequence and metadata validity, extracts compact aerodynamic summaries, and forwards validated data to the safety and actuator paths.
modules.functionality: Accepts compact model response payloads only when a request is pending or a response is expected, validates sequence identity, extracts compact aerodynamic outputs, and rejects malformed or mismatched packets. Any unsupported or bulk content is ignored. It provides compact response metadata for telemetry and downstream safety checks.
responsibilities: Accept model_rsp_valid/model_rsp_data only when response is expected.
Assert model_rsp_ready as the output ready side of the response handshake.
Extract response sequence, validity bits, drag summary, lift summary, and control recommendation summary.
Reject mismatched sequence numbers and flag sequence faults.
Reject malformed responses and flag malformed faults.
Flag timeout if no valid response arrives before the limit.
Do not store bulk flow fields in RTL.
modules.reset_behavior: Deassert ready-related outputs, clear extracted response metadata, and return to idle validation state.
behavior_rules: Only accept responses when a request is pending or response is expected.
Sequence mismatch must be rejected and latched as a fault upstream.
Malformed or unsupported response content must be ignored beyond compact metadata extraction.
Timeout before valid response must be reported as a fault upstream.
Payload width must not exceed 128 bits.

modules.name: aero_safety_monitor
modules.description: Safety monitor implementing stale-data detection, timeout supervision, sequence tracking, and fault latching. It gates command acceptance and provides the canonical fault code and status flags used by firmware and the actuator controller.
modules.functionality: Tracks age and sequence validity, rejects stale response data, latches faults until an explicit software clear when idle, and produces the canonical fault code and status bits. This monitor is the source of truth for safety gating used by the actuator controller and register bank.
responsibilities: Maintain age and sequence supervision.
Reject stale data when response age exceeds STALE_LIMIT.
Reject sequence mismatches and malformed responses as latched faults.
Reject timeout conditions and latch faults.
Allow clear_fault only when idle and explicitly commanded by software.
Provide fault code encoding for stale data, timeout, sequence mismatch, malformed response, and actuator clamp events.
Provide busy/request/response status mirrors to the register bank.
modules.reset_behavior: Clear age tracking, deassert faults, and return to safe idle supervision state. The top-level system remains in fallback-armed safe posture until software re-arms it.
behavior_rules: Faults must latch until software clear_fault while idle.
Stale data beyond STALE_LIMIT must be rejected.
Timeout conditions must be latched.
Sequence mismatch and malformed responses must contribute to the fault code.
No bulk flow data may be stored in this monitor.

modules.name: actuator_clamp_fallback_controller
modules.description: Clamp and fallback actuator controller that selects between validated model-derived commands and a conservative software-configured fallback command, applies [CLAMP_MIN, CLAMP_MAX] bounds, and drives a downstream valid/ready actuator interface.
modules.functionality: Selects the actuator command source, clamps the command to the configured range, and issues a downstream valid/ready command word. If fallback is active or a latched fault exists, it drives the configured fallback command instead of model-derived data. The controller does not update outputs unless safety checks pass.
responsibilities: Clamp all outgoing commands to [CLAMP_MIN, CLAMP_MAX].
Drive FALLBACK_CMD instead of model-derived command when fallback_active or fault_latched is asserted.
Use a safe conservative fallback command on reset and on unrecoverable faults.
Expose last commanded value and clamp/fallback status to telemetry.
Use valid/ready handshake with downstream actuator interface.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, deassert command valid, drive the fallback command on the output path, and assert fallback active status until software re-arms the system.
behavior_rules: Clamp before issuing any actuator command.
If fallback_active is asserted, drive fallback_cmd instead of model-derived command.
No output update is allowed unless safety checks pass.
Fallback is used on reset and on all unrecoverable faults.
Do not expose or compute any large vector actuator representation.

modules.name: uart_debug_mirror
modules.description: UART debug logic that mirrors minimal telemetry and status values for observability without participating in safety-critical control. It is not required for correct operation of the aero control system.
modules.functionality: Serializes compact telemetry and debug state to UART for engineering observability. It mirrors status, last command, response metadata, and fault code but does not affect safety logic or actuator control.
responsibilities: Mirror minimal telemetry to UART.
Remain non-essential to safety and control correctness.
Provide serial transmit and receive ports for debugging.
Avoid dependence on bulk transport or large data captures.
modules.reset_behavior: Return UART transmitter to idle and deassert any debug framing state.
behavior_rules: UART debug may mirror telemetry but shall not be required for safety.
No control effect on actuator or fault logic is permitted.
Only compact telemetry values are mirrored.

top_level_connections.description: Top clock fans out to all synchronous submodules.
Top active-low reset fans out to all submodules.
Firmware-visible Wishbone address input drives the MMIO register bank decode path.
Firmware write data is consumed by the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone byte lane strobes feed the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone write-enable feeds the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone strobe feeds the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone cycle feeds the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone read data is driven by the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone acknowledge is driven by the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone error is driven by the MMIO register bank.
Wishbone stall is driven by the MMIO register bank.
Top model request valid output is driven by the request bridge.
Top model request payload output is driven by the request bridge.
External ready input for model request transport is consumed by the request bridge.
External model response valid input is consumed by the response bridge.
Top model response ready output is driven by the response bridge.
External model response payload input is consumed by the response bridge.
Top actuator command valid output is driven by the actuator controller.
Downstream actuator ready input is consumed by the actuator controller.
Top actuator command word output is driven by the actuator controller.
Top UART transmit output is driven by the debug mirror.
Top UART receive input is consumed by the debug mirror.

inter_module_signals.name: ctrl_clear_fault
inter_module_signals.description: Firmware explicit fault-clear pulse distributed to safety and actuator logic.

inter_module_signals.name: ctrl_request_start

inter_module_signals.name: seq_out

inter_module_signals.name: stale_limit
inter_module_signals.description: Programmable stale-data age threshold forwarded to the safety monitor.

inter_module_signals.name: timeout_limit
inter_module_signals.description: Programmable timeout threshold shared by request, response, and safety supervision.

inter_module_signals.name: clamp_min
inter_module_signals.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator command enforcement.

inter_module_signals.name: clamp_max
inter_module_signals.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator command enforcement.

inter_module_signals.name: fallback_cmd
inter_module_signals.description: Software-configured conservative fallback command value used on reset and faults.

inter_module_signals.name: seq_in
inter_module_signals.description: Validated inbound sequence number returned to the register bank for firmware telemetry.

inter_module_signals.name: request_pending

inter_module_signals.name: request_timed_out

inter_module_signals.name: expected_seq
inter_module_signals.description: Outstanding sequence number distributed to response and safety logic.

inter_module_signals.name: response_valid
inter_module_signals.description: Validated response presence forwarded to safety, actuator, and debug paths.

inter_module_signals.name: response_seq
inter_module_signals.description: Sequence number extracted from the response forwarded to the safety monitor.

inter_module_signals.name: response_age
inter_module_signals.description: Response age forwarded to stale-data supervision.

inter_module_signals.name: sequence_fault
inter_module_signals.description: Sequence mismatch indication forwarded to the safety monitor.

inter_module_signals.name: malformed_fault
inter_module_signals.description: Malformed-response indication forwarded to the safety monitor.

inter_module_signals.name: stale_reject
inter_module_signals.description: Stale data rejection status returned to firmware.

inter_module_signals.name: timeout_fault
inter_module_signals.description: Timeout fault status returned to firmware.

inter_module_signals.name: fault_latched
inter_module_signals.description: Latched fault state distributed to actuator control, debug, and status reporting.

inter_module_signals.name: status_busy
inter_module_signals.description: Busy status mirrored to firmware and UART debug.

inter_module_signals.name: status_request_pending
inter_module_signals.description: Request-pending status mirrored to firmware and UART debug.

inter_module_signals.name: status_response_valid
inter_module_signals.description: Response-valid status mirrored to firmware and UART debug.

inter_module_signals.name: clamp_active
inter_module_signals.description: Clamp-activity indication returned to firmware.

inter_module_signals.name: fallback_active_status
inter_module_signals.description: Fallback-active indication returned to firmware.

inter_module_signals.name: last_cmd

inter_module_signals.name: last_rsp_meta
inter_module_signals.description: Compact response metadata mirrored to firmware and UART debug.

inter_module_signals.name: fault_code
inter_module_signals.description: Canonical fault code mirrored to firmware and UART debug.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register with enable, clear_fault, arm_fallback, and request_start bits.

fields.name: request_start
fields.description: Trigger a new model request when enabled.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Status register exposing busy, request_pending, response_valid, stale_reject, timeout_fault, clamp_active, fallback_active, and fault_latched.

registers.name: STALE_LIMIT
registers.description: Maximum allowable response age before stale rejection.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_LIMIT
registers.description: Maximum cycles to wait for request/response handshake progress.

registers.name: FALLBACK_CMD
registers.description: Conservative fallback command value used on reset and faults.

registers.name: LAST_CMD
registers.description: Last actuator command issued after clamp or fallback selection.

registers.name: LAST_RSP_META
registers.description: Compact response metadata from the external surrogate.

registers.name: FAULT_CODE
registers.description: Latched fault code encoding stale data, timeout, sequence mismatch, malformed response, and actuator clamp events.
